notes_for_editor: No build date, staffing or access detail appears in any source we could read, so the story leaves them out. The abandoned label rests on one blog post and one video title; confirm with the Arkansas Forestry Commission whether the tower still stands and who owns the land. The 110-foot height and 7 x 7 foot cab come only from the Central US Lookouts page; the record's height_m of 33.5 matches the 110-foot figure.
